rules.corroborated: a listed outlet's headline shares at least 50% of the headline's content words and the inference model is at least 60% sure it says the same
rules.disputed: no outlet corroborates, and a listed outlet's headline shares at least 70% of the content words while the model is at least 80% sure it says the opposite
rules.not_found: anything else; this says nothing against the headline
rules.related: when nothing matches, headlines of listed outlets that share at least 30% of the content words are listed as related coverage; they are for the reader to look at and never change the verdict

limits: Only the headline is compared, not the article. Only outlets named in the project's small hand-made directory count; an outlet that is not listed is ignored, and a story that no listed outlet has run (local news, very new news, or old news, which this search rarely returns) comes out as Not found, which says nothing against it. A headline that was copied from a real outlet with a changed article body would still be corroborated. The headline is sent to Google News search (an unofficial feed).

current.description: Headlines read from outlet feeds on 22-23 Nov 2026, distorted copies of them, and invented headlines. The thresholds were chosen from a small grid on this set.
